description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
If Wayward Disciple didn't trigger, resolve the Pious Evangel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
